Sam (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A. Leadership wants a compact list: 1-line why we won, 1-line why we lost (real examples welcome), and one immediate 30/60/90 action we can take. Keep replies short.

Marco (VP Product): Win: customers praise predictable latency and easy model swapping. Loss: friction moving pilots to Private prod. 30d: private quickstart draft; 60d: infra templates; 90d: Console handoff flow.

Leah (Customer Success): Win: hands-on kickoff and clear success plan. Loss: pilot billing surprises and unclear invoice examples. 30d: publish pilot invoice sample + FAQ.

Ethan (Sales): Win: demo latency and fallback stories close deals. Loss: lost RFPs asking for air-gapped install docs and SOC excerpts. 30d: RFP packet (SOC excerpt + KMS notes + network diagram).

Dara (Solutions): Customers ask for a single "security pack" to attach to RFPs. Action: I will assemble an audit bundle skeleton this week (30d).

Priya (Eng): Win: optimized short-seq chat perf. Loss: quantized long-seq regressions in some benchmarks. 60d: long-seq perf smoke-test + rollout guardrails; 90d: CI perf gates.

Marco (VP Product): Leadership asks owners by EOD tomorrow and a KPI per item (e.g., pilot cycle time, RFP conversion for security asks, long-seq p95 latency).

Leah (Customer Success): I'll own pilot invoice sample + collect 3 redacted invoices. @Ethan please DM the examples.

Ethan (Sales): Will DM. Also drafting a 1-page AE card for air-gap rebuttals and next steps.

Dara (Solutions): I'll start the audit bundle doc and invite CS/Legal/Sales.

Priya (Eng): Tagging eng-runtime & eng-infra for the long-seq spike. Will post a short spec in eng-runtime channel.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-8001: "RFP security packet + private quickstart" assigned to Marco+Dara, due in 30 days.

Sam (CEO): Good. Focus: reduce pilot friction and RFP delay. If blockers pop up, escalate to me.

Marco (VP Product): I'll post owners + ticket links here by AM tomorrow. :thumbsup:
